title: Aston Martin’s First EV Pushed Back to 2033 at the Earliest
extract: Aston Martin says its first electric model will not launch until at least 2033, while the company plans to keep V8 and V12 engines viable through the mid-2030s.

title: Aston Martin DB12 S vs. Bentley Continental GT S: Which Is the Grandest Tourer?
extract: Road & Track compares the new DB12 S with Bentley’s hybrid Continental GT S, examining their V8 powertrains, chassis technology and very different approaches to the high-end GT.

title: Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc test rare Ferrari 12Cilindri Manuale at Fiorano
extract: Ferrari F1 drivers Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc have driven the limited-edition 12Cilindri Manuale at Fiorano, an 830-hp naturally aspirated V12 GT using Ferrari’s Manuale-by-wire system.

title: Ferrari faces new Sepang challenge as Fred Vasseur reveals weekend focus
extract: Ferrari is concentrating on race pace for the unusual Sepang weekend, with tyre degradation and the demands of the returning Malaysian circuit shaping the team’s setup approach.

title: The 7-year-old Nvidia Shield TV is now $100 more expensive thanks to AI
extract: Nvidia has raised the price of its long-running Shield TV Pro to $299.99, citing substantially higher component costs, particularly memory, as AI demand reshapes hardware supply chains.

title: Memory executives expect RAM shortage to continue through 2028
extract: Micron and Samsung executives expect tight memory supply to persist for years as AI and server demand consumes more DRAM and HBM manufacturing capacity.

title: With most information hidden, the game Stratego had stumped AI—until now
extract: Researchers from Carnegie Mellon, MIT, NYU and Stanford built Ataraxos, an AI that beat top Stratego player Pim Niemeijer while using a comparatively modest 16-GPU training setup.

title: NASA squeezed Treasury, vibe coded, and broke the mold in bid to save Swift
extract: NASA and Katalyst Space Technologies attempted an unusually rapid rescue of the Swift observatory, combining novel engineering, software work and commercial spacecraft technology even though the mission ultimately fell short.

title: Ghostbusters on Mega Drive gets new characters, weapons and cheats
extract: A new Special Edition update for Sega’s 1990 Mega Drive Ghostbusters game adds six playable characters, new weapons, costumes, cheats and bonus material 36 years after release.

title: Commander Keen 4 returns with a new AmigaOS 68k edition
extract: The classic DOS platformer Commander Keen 4 has been brought to AmigaOS 68k, retaining the original game data while making the 1991 PC title runnable on suitably upgraded Amiga hardware.

title: Dune II Amiga upgrade could add playable Fremen and Sardaukar factions
extract: A current Amiga project is expanding Westwood’s Dune II with substantial control improvements and plans for additional playable factions, revisiting the classic strategy game on original-style hardware.

title: FIFA Street 2012 finally makes its way to Windows
extract: An unofficial Windows project is bringing EA’s 2012 FIFA Street to modern PCs, providing a native modern-machine route to a game originally released for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360.

title: Return of the Jedi brings Atari’s 1984 arcade action to MiSTer
extract: Atari’s 1984 Return of the Jedi arcade game is now playable on MiSTer FPGA, preserving its unusual overhead action and multiple Star Wars vehicle sequences on modern FPGA hardware.

title: Sega Saturn Themed MiSTerFPGA Kit
extract: Df3mod has opened pre-orders for a Sega Saturn-themed MiSTer FPGA kit called Mercury, with a custom shell, 24-bit DAC and Saturn-style video connectivity designed around the DE-10 Nano.

title: Project Ceylon Development Log — October 1, 2026: The Mouse Moved, Asteroids Is Real, and the Hardware Stopped Sitting Still
extract: Project Ceylon’s latest development log reports working keyboard and pointer paths, a real Asteroids application core and improved PCI resource handling in its attempt to imagine an Amiga that never stopped evolving.

title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder is getting an unofficial native PC port
extract: An unofficial project is converting Super Mario Bros. Wonder to a native Windows build, translating Nintendo’s NVN graphics calls to Vulkan rather than relying on conventional Switch emulation.

title: Foo Fighters Join AC/DC for Rescheduled October 2 MetLife Stadium Show
extract: Foo Fighters are scheduled to join AC/DC at MetLife Stadium on October 2 after the rescheduled show, bringing the two bands together for the current Power Up tour date.

title: Groove Armada releases Superstylin’ (Kepler Remix)
extract: Groove Armada has released a new Kepler remix of Superstylin’, a fresh reinterpretation of one of the duo’s best-known tracks.

title: Fleetwood Mac tribute announces 2027 Rumours 50th anniversary tour
extract: Seventh Wonder has announced a 2027 Rumours 50th anniversary tour featuring orchestral performances celebrating Fleetwood Mac’s landmark album.

title: AC/DC returns to MetLife Stadium on October 2
extract: AC/DC’s Power Up tour returns to MetLife Stadium on October 2, with Foo Fighters on the same bill for the rescheduled New Jersey date.

title: Parmigiani Fleurier Debuts the Toric Petite Seconde Morning Blue
extract: Parmigiani Fleurier has introduced a 40.6mm platinum Toric Petite Seconde with a hand-grained gold dial and rose-gold PF780 movement visible through the caseback.

title: Phillips builds on record-breaking sales with New York’s most valuable online auction ever
extract: Phillips has opened bidding on a nearly 90-lot New York online watch auction featuring rare independent and established Swiss watches, including a Voutilainen 28Sport Limited Edition.

title: Windup Watch Fair New York 2026 Sets Its Largest Lineup Yet
extract: The 2026 Windup Watch Fair in New York has announced its largest lineup yet, reflecting the continuing expansion of the collector-focused event.

title: Christopher Ward Marks 15 Years of JJ01 With the C1 Jump Hour XV
extract: Christopher Ward has launched a 300-piece C1 Jump Hour XV celebrating 15 years of its JJ01 module, with a 39mm case and updated dial treatment.

title: Powers by Ursula K. Le Guin arrives in a new Gollancz edition
extract: Gollancz has published a new paperback edition of Ursula K. Le Guin’s Powers, the concluding volume of the Annals of the Western Shore trilogy.

title: The Fires of December by Brandon Sanderson
extract: A new review covers Brandon Sanderson’s The Fires of December, the third Hoid’s Travails novel and a standalone Cosmere story centred on the sardonic storyteller Hoid.

title: The Fires of December by Brandon Sanderson — review
extract: A second contemporary review examines The Fires of December, highlighting its standalone accessibility and science-fiction/fantasy setting within Sanderson’s Cosmere.

title: Legacies of Betrayal: The Third Tale of Witness
extract: Steven Erikson’s Legacies of Betrayal expands the Tale of Witness series with a new Malazan military fantasy story following soldiers caught in a new holy war.

title: Marvel releases one last VisionQuest trailer
extract: Marvel Studios has released a final trailer for VisionQuest, the limited series that completes the trilogy begun by WandaVision and Agatha All Along.

title: Blade Runner 2099 is set for November release
extract: Blade Runner 2099 is listed for a November 2026 Prime Video release, continuing the screen universe inspired by Ridley Scott’s Blade Runner films and Philip K. Dick’s work.

title: Star Wars: Ahsoka Season 2 gets January 2027 premiere listing
extract: SciFi Stream’s current schedule lists Star Wars: Ahsoka Season 2 for a January 20, 2027 premiere, making it one of the next major genre-TV returns on the calendar.
